topics.topic: Backup look scheduling clock, first look, interval anchoring, and suspension behavior
questions: Which time source measures the interval between looks, and does that interval include time while the host or VM is suspended?
Which clock measures the interval between looks, when is the process's first look after starting, and is the interval measured between look starts or after a look finishes?
Which clock measures the interval, when is the first look after process start, and is each look based on a fixed cadence or on the preceding look?

quotes:
- **Passes.** `instance_lifecycle` makes each of its two passes every
  interval from the start, as A13 rule 2 says of the session pass: the n-th
  call is due when `clock.monotonic_reading` shows n intervals since serving
  began, the first one interval after; a call due while the previous call of
  the same pass is still running is not made, and the pass waits for the
  next due one; deadlines that pass during a suspension of the host or a
  long call are not made up. Each time a call returns, the pass takes one
  reading and waits for the first deadline at or after it; when its wait
  ends — on time, or late after a suspension — it makes one call, whatever
  deadlines its wait passed, and takes its next reading when that call
  returns. The passes run apart, neither waiting for the
  other. A look of the backup pass answers at once: a run it starts goes on
  apart from the pass, so the looks go on every interval while a run goes
  on, and a look during a run starts none (A18 rule 1).
judgement.why: State 5 already fixes a monotonic cadence anchored at serving start, with the first look after one interval and one late call after suspension rather than immediate startup or finish-relative scheduling.
options: Use monotonic deadlines from serving start, first look after one interval, counting suspension and making one late call after resume.
Schedule relative to each preceding look or its completion.
consequences: The later text selects the first option; a process starting after the last pre-03:00 deadline may have no qualifying earlier look, and missed deadlines are not replayed.
